Episode 171. Underneath the Imperial Palace... (2)
Yona Runcandel.
As soon as he confronted her appearance and her cold eyes soaked in chaos and killing intent, he almost lost his reason.
However, showing any weakness, even for a moment, in front of such a being was nothing short of suicide.
'Damn it, what the hell did those bastards do to my sister!'
His love and care for his only younger sister was much deeper and greater than his rising hatred for Rosa and the Garden of Swords.
That was why Jin was able to keep his sanity in that moment.
It wasn't a defensive instinct to protect himself, what moved Jin was only to protect his sister.
So that when she came to her senses, she wouldn't be wrapped in guilt and hurt for hurting him.
Clang-!
Bradamante, falling like light, bounced off Yona's sword.
Yona seemed momentarily surprised, as if she hadn't expected him to deflect it so easily, and Dante did not miss that chance.
But Dante didn't capitalize on the moment Yona hesitated. He knew better than anyone what she meant to Jin, and couldn't hurt her carelessly.
He had missed the opportunity to end the situation as soon as it began, and he didn't know what would happen if he couldn't quickly subdue Yona.
While Yona was buying time, the invasion could begin from another tunnel, or she could escape from the two and indiscriminately massacre the people in the fortress.
In this case, Dante thought of his friend's feelings before the safety of the empire.
It was a choice he should never make as the ruler of the empire, but Dante couldn't help it.
"Thank you, Dante."
"Ho, what should we do? Embarrassingly, I ask you this question too often."
Jin quickly regained his composure.
His anger was stronger than ever, but at the same time, his mind and inner self were more solid than ever. Because even a slight mistake from now on could mean losing Yona.
'She's in a state of rampage with her spiritual energy, and the Prophet must have played some trick on her.'
For that reason, Yona seemed more ferocious than the one Jin knew. She was more destructive, but certainly her shadow-like movements were faded.
Could she be subdued?
A conclusion came after two more exchanges of offense and defense.
"Dante, I think we can subdue my sister if you and I get a little hurt."
If it's not subduing but killing, it's entirely possible without any such damage.
From Dante's perspective, it is obviously right to kill Yona, and Jin was making an unreasonable request.
"Alright."
However, Dante didn't hesitate at all. If it had been Ron in the tunnel, he would have made the same request to Jin.
"I owe you a big one."
"Nonsense. I have a long way to go to repay what I've received from you so far."
Whooosh-!
Jin layered spiritual energy onto Bradamante.
Despite the intense spiritual energy flaming like fire and targeting him, Yona showed no particular reaction.
'Is it because she has no reason? If she were my sister, she should have a strong rejection to the spiritual energy.'
Yona was calmly pointing her sword at Bradamante, which was covered in spiritual energy.
The sword was also not Yona's sword, 'Death'. It looked like 'Death' at a glance, but it was longer, and above all, it didn't have the unique chilling feeling.
"Huff!"
Dante, who stepped aside with a sword technique, let out a sigh. A few of Dante's hair was cut by Yona's blade. She had decided to eliminate Dante first.
"We may need to prepare for a serious injury."
"There doesn't seem to be much fighting outside yet. No trouble at all."
"Do you feel it from here?"
"Thanks to a little experience with the senses of an apostle. I hope this tunnel was created only to infiltrate Sister Yona."
Dante was already on his toes just by keeping Yona in check, he couldn't pay attention to anything else.
Even if that hadn't been the case, it would have been overwhelming for him to read the atmosphere outside from within this deep tunnel.
"You've become a monster, after all."
"That's why these trials keep coming."
As Jin started to hold her back in earnest, Yona had to change her plan to deal with Dante first.

A joint attack of the swordsman closest to being the world's strongest and the empire's top swordsman. Moreover, the two harmonized like twins, so what Yona could do was almost entirely a desperate, indiscriminate attack.

However, the problem was that each of those attacks was lethal. Even if she had become numb, a life-threatening situation was a life-threatening situation, and the darkness of the tunnel made her more free.
If it seemed she was in front, a sword came out from behind, and if they thought they had fended her off, another stab came in from the side.
The fact that she could create angles and dig in, even while Jin and Dante were fighting back to back, was something only Yona could do.
[Uh... Die... Jin... Runcandel...]
She didn't look like Yona at all.
Even though that fact continually scratched his inner mind, Jin did not lose his composure.
"I remember the first day I went to Moomyeong. I almost died to you with this friend too."
[Kill... it...!]
"Like then, you can't kill me today either. I will definitely make it so, for you."
There were quite a few moments when Jin and Dante could end Yona together. However, the opportunity to suppress never came, and the two were increasing their residual wounds.
Yona began to attempt increasingly bold and dangerous attacks after recognizing that the two people did not even attempt to cut her deeply.
"Is it still okay outside?"
"If it seems like the situation has exploded, let me know immediately... wait, Dante."
"Has it started!?"
"Not that. You called me a monster a while ago, right?"
"What all of a sudden?"
Monster. A word that was accurately recorded in Valeria's record magic window, unlike the name '... Runkandel'.
'Why did Valeria's record specifically refer to Yona as a monster?'
-If it was Joshua, is there a reason why his name would not appear exactly in the record magic?
-Well, it could be because he accepted chaos and became a completely new being. Of course, I can't be sure, it's just a hunch.
Suddenly, the conversation with the colleagues before coming to Geomhwangseong came to mind.
'If, as speculated at the time, it became a new being by accepting chaos, it should have been processed blankly. Is there a difference between Yona and ... Runkandel?'
Then, Yona might not be Yona?
He thought so. Maybe, like creating a clone of Joshua, the prophet created a clone of Yona or something else.

'Besides, judging by the situation, it doesn't seem to be controlled properly. It's strange to make this wide tunnel for Yona alone. If he thought of sending more characters, the outside should have been chaotic already. It would be most effective to hit the outside when Dante and I are tied up here.'
If Yona in front of him is not the 'real Yona', there is no need to endure the wounds and suppress him. And that Yona, had nothing in common with the Yona Jin knew.
'If it were Yona, she would have suffered at least once. Even if Helrum or Gleak, not the prophet, directly eroded her, she would have been painful to fight me at least once...'
The Yona Jin knew was that kind of person.
Always precarious because of the chaos, killed people for no particular reason for a long time because of the chaos, and always terrified others because of the chaos.
The person who defeated that terrible chaos and finally loved Jin, family, and people.
The youngest sister who weaved a green rose to Jin while constantly hearing a voice telling him to kill a human.
"Dante, go outside."
"Jin, don't think of giving up on Yona. Don't do that!"
"I don't intend to do that. I'll be buying time, so go get Yuria."
"Princess Yuria?"
"Yona may not be Yona. I'll explain the details later. I can't face it alone for long."
Even the two of them had to brace themselves for considerable injuries if they wanted to suppres
s Yona. It's only natural since she's merely receiving hits like a scarecrow.
"I'll be back as soon as possible!"
As Dante turned his back, Yona's blade surged without fail. Jin blocked Yona, parrying the barely visible sword.

"I felt like I was going crazy with a filthy and ominous feeling that I didn't know why, but now it feels like my throat is clearing up and my head is getting clearer. I don't think she's the real sister."
Pik-!
Yona's sword grazed Jin's cheek and passed by.
Jin still didn't exploit her weaknesses.
He faced Yona alone like that for about ten minutes.
Jin was bloodied, but his breathing and movements did not change at all. Instead, the sense that had been covering the outside was now focused only on Yona.
"Jin!"
"Brother Jin!"
As soon as he saw Jin soaked in blood, Dante gritted his teeth, but Yuria wasn't so shocked when she recognized that there were no deep wounds at first glance.
"How's the outside?"
This time, Jin asked Dante.
"It's fine, are you alright!"
"Brother Jin is okay. And, that person."
Yuria, who briefly focused and manifested the power of Az Mil.
Her eyes were dyed green, understanding the truth about Yona.
"She's not Sister Yona!"
"Is it a clone like Joshua?"
"I don't think it's that either, just... a soulless combat puppet. That's how it appears to me."
"Are you sure it's not Yona?"
"Absolutely not."
As soon as Yuria's confirmation was finished.
Jin lost strength in his legs and ended up kneeling on the ground.
An indescribably deep sense of relief was coming at the fact that Yona wasn't the real one.
Of course, the fake Yona rushed forward to finish Jin in that gap, and Dante shot a sword aura in surprise to protect Jin.
Yona's sword was faster than that sword aura.
However, Jin, while kneeling, swung Bradamante and knocked off the fake Yona's sword in a single moment, and even cut her neck.
"That's right... I thought so. Our sister Yona couldn't have been like this."
The fake Yona, with her head falling off, was twitching for a while and then disappearing as she oxidized.
In the place where she disappeared, there was a single lump of black left.
